messages:
zoe: Quick review: keyboard scrubbing is great but users asked for clearer step granularity. Right now left/right arrows move by an internal step that isn't surfaced anywhere. Can we show the step size in the UI and announce it for screen readers?

henry: Agree. Proposed control: a small inline control next to the scrubber labelled 'Scrub by: 1m' with a chevron to pick 1m/5m/1h. Defaults should depend on range (last 1h -> 1m, last 24h -> 5m).

maria: Love it. UX note: keep the control minimal and keyboard friendly. If the control is focused, arrow keys should change the step; Enter opens the picker. Also the active step should be included in the aria-label: e.g., 'Scrub step, 5 minutes'.

a11y-team: For SRs please avoid abbreviations: announce "scrub step: five minutes" not "5m". Also use aria-live politely for scrubbing updates: 'Chart percentiles: p95 one hundred eighty milliseconds'.

zoe: Microcopy suggestion for the control tooltip: 'Adjust keyboard scrub step. Larger steps speed navigation across long ranges; smaller steps give finer control.' Keep the phrase 'approximate' out of the tooltip.

henry: Implementation approach: render the scrubber thumb and step control in an overlay layer so layout recalculations don't move them. When step changes, update a data-step attr for CSS and set aria-live to announce "Scrub step set to X".

maria: Also request: when user holds Shift+arrow, multiply step by 10 (accelerated scrub). Announce acceleration mode: 'Accelerated scrub: ten minute steps'.

dev-bot: Dev preview built: https://staging.redwood.ai/heatmap/preview/2175009999 (includes scrub-step picker, overlay thumb, aria-live updates). CI status: green.

henry: Small perf concern: we must not recalc bucket widths on every keypress. We'll debounce render recalcs (40ms while scrubbing, 150ms idle). That reduces layout thrash.

a11y-team: Also ensure the scrub-step picker itself is reachable via keyboard; provide an accessible label and focus styles. Add a preference to hide step control for compact mode.

zoe: Copy tweak: change the toggle 'Sampling' hover text to: 'Sampling reduces compute on large ranges by approximating percentiles. Turn off for exact values.' Avoid parentheses.

maria: Sounds good. One more: when step changes, update the visible scrubber tooltip to include step: 'p95 180ms (step: 5m)'. This helps sighted and non-sighted users.

henry: I'll land a small PR that adds the picker, aria-live announcements, overlay rendering, and the debounce. Will keep bucket virtualization unchanged.

dev-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/9955. Deployed to staging for testing.

a11y-team: Testing notes: NVDA reads the live announcements correctly; VoiceOver announces step changes but prefers full words for units. All good after microcopy updates.

zoe: OK to ship as a minor UX + a11y improvement. Changelog: 'Heatmap: keyboard scrub step picker; audible scrub-step & p95 announcements; clarified sampling tooltip copy.'

maria: I'll add copy patches to the console translations and queue release notes. Thanks team :sparkles:
